posts.title: Meanwhile, the ICE gestapo continue their useless harassment…
posts.description: …this time of a PhD student in neuroscience at Princeton, who is from China, who was boarding a domestic flight after presenting at a conference. Fortunately, a federal judge has already ordered that she not be removed from the Virginia detention facility she is currently in. I hope the judge expedites a bit more!
